metadata.ncrpbMeetingReference: NCRPB extent retained as of 16 June 2026

districts: Charkhi Dadri (within Bhiwani polygon in 2021 LGD release)

metadata.conversionMethodology: Filtered 34 verified NCRPB constituent ADM2 WGS84 polygons from geoBoundaries IND-ADM2-76128533 (derived from lgdirectory.gov.in), verified zero unclosed rings, zero duplicate consecutive vertices, zero self-intersections, and dissolved into a single valid PostGIS MultiPolygon (SRID 4326) via ST_Multi(ST_MakeValid(ST_UnaryUnion(ST_Collect(...)))).
knownLimitations: Uses geoBoundaries simplified ADM2 geometry (~9,510 vertices across 34 constituent polygons); outer boundary accuracy is approximately 100-300 m relative to Survey of India cadastral parcels.
Haryana Charkhi Dadri district (carved out of Bhiwani) is enclosed within the unified Bhiwani ADM2 polygon in the 2021 LGD geometry; both districts are 100% within NCR.

Rajasthan 2023 district splits (Deeg, Khairthal-Tijara, Kotputli-Behror carved from Alwar/Bharatpur) are covered by the historic Alwar and Bharatpur extents matching NCRPB retention of existing NCR geographic extent.

NCRPB PARIMAN (ncrpbgis.nic.in) does not expose public bulk WFS/Shapefile downloads; therefore this dataset combines NCRPB official constituent notification with government-derived lgdirectory.gov.in ADM2 geometry.
